_comment: Paste the `hooks` block below into .claude/settings.json to switch on
enforced activity logging. It is NOT active until you do.
These four events give full coverage of a nested agent tree:
SubagentStart  - an employee is hired onto a task
PreToolUse     - fires INSIDE subagents, carries agent_id + agent_type
Known coverage gaps, documented rather than hidden:
- schema/validation rejections fire neither PreToolUse nor PostToolUseFailure
- `disableAllHooks: true` in any settings file switches all of this off.
Only managed policy settings survive that, so if 'enforced' must mean
'nobody can turn it off', these belong in managed policy instead.
PostToolUse is the noisy one - it fires on every tool call by every agent
at every depth. Drop it if activity.jsonl grows faster than you want.
